corpus: ~/code/agent-lab (read-only, revision at authoring time: see corpus_head_sha in the sealing receipt)
method: Every question below was written by a human-directed agent after reading the named file's actual content (not generated from filenames or docstrings alone). Gold spans are file path plus 1-based inclusive line ranges in the source file as read at authoring time. Disjoint from fixtures/rag-note.md, which was not read to write these questions.
scoring_note: A retrieval hit counts for a question if the returned chunk's (path, line-range) overlaps by at least one line with any gold span for that question, after normalizing paths to be repo-relative.
